summary: Frontend-only E2E review completed on the public URL. The reported image bug is fixed: Hero, first fleet bike, and first testimonial URL edits updated loaded images immediately and persisted after reload. Hero text/subtitle multi-edit persistence, add/remove across all six list types, reset, and mobile layout smoke tests passed. Color CSS variables persist, but accent button fills are broken and background changes are largely hidden by hardcoded section backgrounds. Added blank-image items also emit browser errors, and the original requirement that every visible text be editable is incomplete.

ui_bugs.component: Dynamic accent styling / Admin Save and public CTA buttons
ui_bugs.issue: Elements using bg-accent-nb compute to a transparent background, so accent-colored buttons do not reflect the selected color; on the dark Admin header the black Save label/icon is effectively invisible. --nb-accent-rgb is emitted as comma-separated channels while Tailwind generates rgb(var(--nb-accent-rgb) / alpha), an invalid comma-plus-slash CSS form.

New bike and testimonial defaults use image/photo='', but the public components still render . React logs repeated empty-src errors and the browser may request the current page instead of displaying a usable placeholder.

integration_issues.issue: Saving background color updates --nb-bg and the body, but .App and nearly every section use hardcoded bg colors, covering the body. In the tested #EEF2FF state, body was rgb(238,242,255) while .App remained rgb(244,245,247) and Hero remained rgb(238,241,245), so the setting does not visibly theme the page as expected.

The Admin panel does not expose all public copy. Navbar labels/CTAs, marquee words, section eyebrow labels, location labels/buttons, fleet helper/price labels, and footer headings/legal labels remain hardcoded in components.

issues: Radix logs Missing Description/aria-describedby warnings whenever the Sheet opens.
The category remove control and many editable controls/preset swatches have no data-testid, contrary to the app testability requirement.

action_items: Change --nb-accent-rgb to space-separated channels (for example '234 88 12') or change Tailwind accent-nb to a CSS syntax compatible with comma-separated values; verify Save, Hero CTA, nav CTA, filters, and other accent fills have non-transparent computed backgrounds.
Use var(--nb-bg) in the App/section backgrounds (or provide separate editable section colors) instead of hardcoded background utility values.
Provide a valid placeholder/default image for newly added bikes and testimonials, or conditionally omit the img element until a URL is set.
Move all remaining hardcoded public copy into defaultConfig and expose corresponding Admin fields to fulfill the edit-everything requirement.
Add Sheet description/aria-describedby and missing data-testid attributes, especially remove-category-<index>.
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigContext.jsx hexToRgb returns comma-separated channels, but tailwind.config.js defines accent-nb as rgb(var(--nb-accent-rgb) / <alpha-value>); this makes generated accent background CSS invalid and transparent.
App.js and section components hardcode background classes, so applying --nb-bg at body/root does not theme the visible application.
AdminPanel.jsx creates new bike/testimonial records with empty image fields while Frota.jsx and SocialProof.jsx render those values unconditionally.
The edit-everything requirement remains unmet because multiple components contain user-visible constants outside defaultConfig/AdminPanel.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily saved TESTE HEADLINE, subtitle, three direct image URLs, two colors, and one item for each editable list. Verified backend persistence after reload, then removed test additions and used Admin Reset. Final GET /api/config returned {key:'site', data:null}; defaults were restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest accent computed backgrounds, visible page background theming, empty-image add behavior, and new Admin fields for formerly hardcoded copy. Image URL editing and list persistence already passed. Public data was reset to defaults at completion.
rca_of_the_issue: Image editing now works because draft mutations reach section config and PUT persistence. Remaining color failure is caused by incompatible CSS variable channel formatting: hexToRgb supplies 'r, g, b' while Tailwind's slash-alpha rgb() requires space-separated channels. Background customization is obscured by hardcoded descendant backgrounds. Empty-image errors come from newly added item defaults combined with unconditional img rendering.
